Subject: Sprint Zero: POC kickstart — working session scheduling & post-run actions

Hi Ellie / Samir,

Thanks again for agreeing to run Sprint Zero with us next week. I want to lock in a 90-minute hands-on working session focused on three concrete items:

- Prompt review & evaluation (bring 6–8 canonical prompts)
- Routing & prefix caching plan (quick review of sample traffic)
- Short throughput run (30–45 minute load test of core scenario)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jun 1, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 2, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jun 3, 09:00–10:30

Please tell us which slot works best (or share alternatives). I’ve attached a lightweight agenda (sprint0-agenda.pdf) and a CSV with example prompts (sample-prompts.csv) so you can prep.

Partners on our side: Marissa (solutions engineer) will lead the hands-on session; Karthik will own the routing/load test configuration.

High-level goals for the session: validate prompt outputs, confirm routing/quantization hypothesis, and capture runbook actions + owners for Phase 1.

Thanks — excited to get started.

—Logan

Logan — thanks for the clear agenda and the attachments. Wed Jun 2 at 14:00 PST looks best for us; that gives our ML engineer time to prep.

A couple quick asks before the session:
- Can you add a short step to validate anonymized production-like payloads? We won’t send PII, but we want to exercise the same token lengths and routing patterns.
- For the load test, we’d like a 5-minute warmup + a 20-minute steady window that mirrors our 90th percentile burst. Is that doable in your runbook?

If yes to both, we’re happy with Wed 14:00. I’ll tentatively accept and wait for a calendar invite.

Best,

Thanks everyone — great session today. Recap + open actions below (follow-up items capture from the working session).

Session summary:
- Reviewed 7 canonical prompts from Neptune (see sample-prompts.csv). Prompt adjustments made live for two templates (reducing system content to avoid repetition).
- Verified anonymized payloads and confirmed token distribution matched the 90th percentile burst pattern.
- Routing plan validated: Karthik ran a steady 20-minute throughput window (5-minute warmup) at target QPS; KV cache hit-rate observed ~62% on the test slice.

Open actions (owner — due):
1) Neptune: share anonymized production sample for extended validation (Samir) — due 2027-06-07.
2) Redwood: generate quantization recommendation matrix and expected cost delta (Marissa) — due 2027-06-04.
3) Redwood infra: tune batch threshold + re-run 1-hour soak on staging (Karthik) — due 2027-06-09.
4) Joint: plan follow-up deep-dive on output quality (examples + evaluation harness) — propose dates by 2027-06-06 (Logan/ Ellie).

Next session: propose Thu Jun 10, 10:00–11:30 PST or Tue Jun 14, 13:00–14:30 PST. Please reply with preferred slot. I’ll circulate meeting notes and upload logs to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC-sprint0 (logs in /run-20270601).

Thanks — good progress.

—Marissa Cole
